suppress.notes: Evidence (reviewed 2026-11-23): https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf CVE-2026-54285 affects npm @opentelemetry/core (opentelemetry-js before 2.8.0), not io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-api (Java). OWASP CPE heuristic incorrectly associates the JS product with this particular Java artifact version. Exempt ONLY this exact GAV and CVE; all other CVEs and all future versions remain scanned. Java API/SDK are kept aligned by io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-bom.

Same JS-only CVE matched to Java SDK, also a false positive: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf This rule is limited to Java SDK 1.68.0 and this single CVE. All other vulnerability IDs stay reportable and blocking.
